textos.Con balun impreso: el boom (la tira de m: With printed balun: the boom (the ground strip under the line) is part of the balun; do not trim it or put copper at its sides.
textos.Con brazos anchos de tipo parche no func: With wide patch-like arms it does not work: 4 to 12 times the track width gives −6.7 to −1.6 dB at 2.4 GHz and −5.8 to −2.2 dB at 5.8 GHz even after re-centring the length. For more bandwidth use the bowtie.
textos.Con coaxial al centro: vivo al brazo der: With coax at the centre: live conductor to the right arm and braid to the left, and take the cable out perpendicular to the arms for at least λ/4 before bending it; a ferrite next to the solder joint stops the braid radiating.

textos.Con el conector IPEX a 2,4 GHz la masa a: With the IPEX connector at 2.4 GHz the automatic ground gives −6.9 dB; with a manual ground (length 25 mm, width 40 mm) it matches (−14.6 dB, η 95 %).
textos.Con elementos de Koch: la iteración 1 ad: With Koch elements: iteration 1 matches (−21 dB) but radiates backwards; iteration 2 at 2.4 GHz does work with the beam pointing forward (−14.4 dB, η 81 %, with the reflector ×1.35 and the director ×0.76), but with only 2.6 dBi. textos.Con la red en L no llega a −10 dB (mínim: With the L network it does not reach −10 dB (minimum {0:.1f} dB): the E24 values are not enough, adjust the network.
textos.Con los directores unidos al boom la fre: With the directors joined to the boom the frequency jumps between modes while tuning and the match is slightly worse than with separate directors.
textos.Con masa compacta el cable forma parte d: With a compact ground the cable becomes part of the antenna: measure with a ferrite on the coax 2–3 cm from the board and without touching the board.
textos.Con muchos tramos, la corriente decae ha: With many sections the current decays towards the tip and the gain barely grows.
textos.Con parásitos cerca, el dipolo baja a ~1: With parasitic elements nearby, the dipole drops to ~10–15 Ω: the transformer or the folding takes it to 50 Ω
textos.Con recortes de aligerado (aligerado = 1: With lightening cutouts (aligerado = 1): at 868 MHz and 5.8 GHz it hardly changes (−8.6 dB and −12.0 dB, η 87 % and 72 %; the frequency rises 6–8 %), but at 2.4 GHz with the default margin the match drops to −2.3 dB and the beam flips; with a 6 mm margin it gives −6.0 dB, η 75 %, beam forward. textos.Dipolo de media onda con brazos triangul: Half-wave dipole with triangular arms (or Sierpinski triangles): more bandwidth than the straight one and it tolerates εr detuning better. Omnidirectional (~2 dBi). With SMA and printed balun or coax at the centre.
textos.Dipolo de media onda, omnidireccional en: Half-wave dipole, omnidirectional in the plane perpendicular to the arms (~2 dBi). With SMA and printed balun (one arm on each face) or with coax soldered at the centre.
textos.Dipolo impreso (recto o de Koch) con bal: Printed dipole (straight or Koch) with balun: no ground plane needed, symmetric radiation.
textos.Dipolos en serie (U al vivo, U invertida: Dipoles in series (U on the live side, inverted U on the ground side) joined by λg microstrip: more omni gain.
textos.Dipolos impresos (un brazo en cada cara): Printed dipoles (one arm on each face) with an H network of parallel strips, over a reflector separated by air (second board or metal sheet). Rear coax, at the centre. Beam towards the side opposite the reflector; 2×2 ≈ 12–13 dBi and 4×4 ≈ 16–17 dBi, minus the network losses.
textos.Dipolos o bowtie sobre un reflector (seg: Dipoles or bowtie over a reflector (second board): 1 element or 2×2 / 4×4, up to 17 dBi for long links.
textos.Dirección del máximo: θ {0:g}°, φ {1:g}°: Direction of the maximum: θ {0:g}°, φ {1:g}°
textos.Directa: el dipolo va tal cual; adapta a: Direct: the dipole is used as is; it matches by moving the reflector away (longer board), and it is the validated one. λ/4 transformer: matches with the reflector close, but with narrow band. Folded dipole: in simulation it radiated backwards.
textos.Directores muy juntos para tantos elemen: Directors very close together for so many elements: typical spacing 0.15–0.3 λ0.
textos.Disposición de los dipolos. «Todos igual: Dipole layout. «All equal» matches better; the symmetric one does not correct the beam tilt.
textos.Disposición simétrica: tras el cruce de: Symmetric layout: after the via crossing, the bottom-face copper of the left half goes to the live conductor, not to ground. The braid is soldered only to the central pad; do not connect any other board copper to the reflector or to the coax.

textos.Distancia entre dipolos, en longitudes d: Distance between dipoles, in wavelengths. ~0.75 λ0 gives the maximum gain.
textos.Distancia entre ejes del conductor parti: Distance between the axes of the split conductor and the whole one
textos.Distancia entre el cortocircuito a masa: Distance between the short to ground and the feed tap. Sets the impedance.
textos.Distancia entre el cortocircuito y la to: Distance between the short-circuit and the tap [mm]
textos.Distancia entre el dipolo y los director: Distance between the dipole and the directors, and between directors.
textos.Distancia entre el divisor de la aliment: Distance between the feed splitter and the edge of the ground.
textos.Distancia entre la curva y el borde del: Distance between the curve and the edge of the ground plane.
textos.Distancia entre la red de alimentación y: Distance between the feed network and the patches.
textos.Distancia entre los dos conductores del: Distance between the two conductors of the folded dipole.
textos.Distancia entre parches, en longitudes d: Distance between patches, in wavelengths. ~0.7–0.8 λ0 gives the maximum gain without large side lobes.
textos.Distancia mínima del cobre al borde de l: Minimum distance from the copper to the board edge (the manufacturer does not allow copper right at the edge).
textos.Distancia mínima entre las ventanas y el: Minimum distance between the windows and the copper.
textos.Distancia: batería, blindajes y pantalla: Distance: keep battery, shields and screens at least λ/10 ({0:.0f} mm) from the antenna zone. In simulation, a metal battery right behind raises the frequency by ~6 % and an ABS case lowers it by ~7 % (tick Environment in Simulation).
textos.Dos aletas exponenciales, una en cada ca: Two exponential fins, one on each face: wide band and directional towards the mouth (~5–7 dBi). Large at 868 MHz.
textos.Dos bandas (la baja del diseño y 2,4 GHz: Two bands (the design’s low band and 2.4 GHz)
textos.Dos bandas (la segunda, a ~3 veces la pr: Two bands (the second at ~3 times the first)
textos.Dos bandas, experimental: con una malla: Two bands, experimental: with a 1 mm mesh the simulation gives −10 to −12 dB at 868 MHz and 2.4 GHz, but with another mesh the high band collapses (−3 to −7 dB): the result is fragile and a difference of a few millimetres when manufacturing can take it out of −10 dB. 18 variants of the second branch dimensions were tested with three mesh steps: none gives −8 dB in both bands with all of them. Only tested with the low band at 868 MHz. Simulate it (with the mesh check) and measure it before trusting it. It is not tuned like the single-band ones: the simulation measures both bands at once.
textos.Dos bandas: añade el brazo de 2,4 GHz. S: Two bands: adds the 2.4 GHz arm. Simulated with the low band at 868 MHz (J-pole: two joined J-poles; IFA: second branch); the high band is always 2.4 GHz
textos.Dos bandas: el diseño se ajusta a la ban: Two bands: the design is tuned to the low band and, with 85° aperture and iteration 2, the second resonance falls near 3 times its frequency (868/915 MHz and 2.4 GHz in simulation)
textos.Dos bandas: la banda de uso es la BAJA (: Two bands: the band of use is the LOW one (868 or 915 MHz); the high one comes out on its own at ~2.4 GHz. Choose 868 or 915 MHz above.
textos.Dos bandas: simulado con la banda baja e: Two bands: simulated with the low band at 868–870, 902–928 or 863–928 MHz and the high one at 2400–2483.5 MHz (S11 of −10 to −13 dB in both, ~2 dBi low and ~4.5 dBi high); for other bands, simulate it. Large board (~96 × 115 mm).
textos.Dónde va la antena en el borde superior: Where the antenna goes on the top edge of the board: in a corner or centered.
textos.Eficiencia baja en FR4 (~33 % en la iter: Low efficiency on FR4 (~33 % at iteration 1, gain ~1 dBi) and narrow band (~36–41 MHz). On RO4350B η 76 % and 5.2 dBi, but the band is only ~19 MHz. At 5.8 GHz −8.5 dB.
textos.Eficiencia de radiación del {0:.0f} %: c: Radiation efficiency of {0:.0f} %: it hardly radiates at {1:.0f} MHz. Probably a false resonance (disconnected piece in the model or a line resonance); check the geometry.
textos.El Hilbert es muy compacto pero sensible: The Hilbert curve is very compact but sensitive to manufacturing: keep the gap between turns ≥ 2 times the track width.
textos.El IPEX ocupa {0:.1f} mm desde el borde: The IPEX takes {0:.1f} mm from the edge and covers copper that is not the 50 Ω line: lengthen the feed line.
textos.El PTFE sube la eficiencia del parche (~: PTFE raises the patch efficiency (~90 % versus ~47 % on FR4) but does not widen the band: with 1.65 mm it is still ~35 MHz at 2.4 GHz. More bandwidth needs a thicker board or a lower εr.
textos.El adaptador λ/4 se calcula solo; esto l: The λ/4 adapter is computed automatically; this lengthens or shortens it
textos.El ajuste no itera la frecuencia (el S11: The tuning does not iterate the frequency (the corporate network's S11 is rippled): the initial size is calibrated with 2×2 simulations at 2.4 GHz and at 5.8 GHz (6.6 mm arm: −10.5 dB across the whole band, but the S11 changes a lot with the length and with the mesh: a +15 % step leaves it at −4.7 dB); at 868 MHz it has not been simulated (383 × 283 mm board) and for the 4×4, simulate it. With the fine mesh the beam comes out almost straight ahead (0–3°): the earlier 9° tilt was a mesh artefact. In the 2×2 Sierpinski, iterations 1, 2 and 3 give the same (≈12.6 dBi, same arm length). At 2.4 GHz −10.1 dB with the reflector at 0.125–0.163 λ and the arm ×1.04; at 5.8 GHz −9.8 dB with the reflector at 0.175 λ and the arm ×0.82. With lightening cutouts at 2.4 GHz, −7.8 dB (the frequency rises 3 %).
textos.El ancho de banda estimado ({0:g} MHz) n: The estimated bandwidth ({0:g} MHz) does not cover the {1:g} MHz band: press «Widen bandwidth» or change the type.
textos.El anillo redondo (diámetro = lado) tien: The round ring (diameter = side) has less perimeter than the square one: it resonates higher. Uncalibrated
textos.El anillo redondo de menos de {0:g} mm (: The round ring of less than {0:g} mm (diameter {1:g} mm) cannot be fed properly: the line, the feed gap and the via do not fit in such a small circle (in simulation it resonates 38 % higher than expected). Use the square ring or a larger diameter.
textos.El dipolo plegado se hace siempre recto:: The folded dipole is always straight: the Koch iteration only affects the parasitic elements.
textos.El diseño no estaba guardado (o cambió d: The design was not saved (or changed during the simulation): the result stays only in salidas/_simulaciones.
textos.El haz sale por el lado de los dipolos (: The beam leaves on the side of the dipoles (away from the reflector), with polarization parallel to the arms: for Meshtastic, mount the panel with the arms vertical.
textos.El hueco más estrecho ({0:.2f} mm) queda: The narrowest gap ({0:.2f} mm) has fewer than 2 cells: the result may come out short-circuited; use «fine» precision.
textos.El meandro adapta mal en una placa peque: The meander matches poorly on a small board (in simulation, at 2.4 GHz and 868 MHz it does not reach −10 dB with boards up to 80 × 120 mm): for a product board, the IFA is the proven option.
textos.El panel admite un solo elemento, 2×2 o: The panel accepts a single element, 2×2 or 4×4
textos.El plano de masa debajo del parche debe: The ground plane under the patch must be continuous; extend at least 6 times the substrate thickness on each side.
textos.El plano de masa hace de reflector: debe: The ground plane acts as a reflector: it must be electrically longer than the dipole (≈ λ0/2 wide or more); if narrower it acts as a director and the beam goes backwards.
The port does not fall on the mesh ({0} = {1:.4f} mm): openEMS would discard it and the simulation would run without excitation
textos.El reflector debe ser un 5–10 % más larg: The reflector must be 5–10 % longer than the dipole and 0.15–0.25 λ0 away; moving it closer lowers the impedance and the efficiency.
textos.El resultado depende de la malla: no te: The result depends on the mesh: do not trust a single point, measure the antenna.
The result does not depend on the mesh.
textos.El sustrato de 4 capas solo vale con una: The 4-layer substrate only works with an antenna integrated into a board (ifa, straight, Koch or meander monopole): in the other types the ground is on the bottom face.

textos.En serie en el anillo (C0G/NP0 de Q alta: In series in the ring (high-Q C0G/NP0). With more capacitance the ring resonates lower; the parasitic capacitance of the gap and pads adds ~0.15 pF. “Resize to the frequency” chooses this value

textos.Fija la impedancia: más separada, más im: Sets the impedance: further apart, higher impedance
textos.Flex de JLC: sin impedancia controlada,: JLC flex: no controlled impedance, and a 50 Ω microstrip would come out at ~0.06–0.12 mm. Use types with the coax soldered to the antenna (dipole, bowtie, J-pole) and the rules “JLC high frequency and flex (0.1 mm)”.
textos.Forma de cada elemento: dipolo recto, bo: Shape of each element: straight dipole, bowtie (triangles) or Sierpinski bowtie. The bowtie tolerates frequency deviations better (more bandwidth).
textos.Forma de cada parche: rectangular o frac: Shape of each patch: rectangular or Minkowski fractal.
textos.Forma de la placa: rectangular o ajustad: Board shape: rectangular or fitted to the antenna (rounded corners, less FR4).
textos.Frecuencia cambiada: pulsa «Ajustar tama: Frequency changed: press «Resize to the frequency».
textos.GPS e Iridium emiten con polarización ci: GPS and Iridium transmit with circular polarisation and this antenna is linear: you lose ~3 dB. For good receive sensitivity you need a circularly polarised patch.
textos.GPU no disponible ({0}): se usa la CPU: GPU not available ({0}): the CPU is used

textos.IPEX / U.FL (MHF1, no MHF4): aguanta ~30: IPEX / U.FL (MHF1, not MHF4): withstands ~30 mating cycles. The 1.13 mm pigtail loses ~0.5 dB per 10 cm at 2.4 GHz (~0.3 dB at 868 MHz): keep it as short as possible.
textos.IPEX: encima de la placa a 3 mm del bord: IPEX: on top of the board, 3 mm from the edge; the minimum ground of the monopoles drops from 12 to 7 mm and the minimum width from 16 to 8 mm. Soldered coaxial: no connector, with a pad for the center conductor on the line and another for the shield, tied to ground. RF pad: no connector, a pad at the end of the 50 Ω line with two ground vias beside it, to reach it with your product line
textos.Impedancia del tramo λ/4 que adapta el d: Impedance of the λ/4 section that matches the dipole to 50 Ω.
textos.Inserción acortada para no partir el par: Feed insertion shortened so as not to split the patch (narrow central neck): the match will be worse; use a lower Minkowski iteration or depth.
textos.Iteración 3 o más: los detalles son pequ: Iteration 3 or more: the details are tiny and the size gain marginal; iteration 2 is usually the best compromise.
textos.Iteración de Koch de los elementos (0 =: Koch iteration of the elements (0 = straight)
textos.Iteración del fractal de Minkowski de ca: Minkowski fractal iteration of each patch (if the element is Minkowski).
textos.Iteración {0}: eficiencia ~30 % y gananc: Iteration {0}: efficiency ~30 % and gain < 1 dBi in simulation (it matches, but hardly radiates); the size estimate is off by 10–40 %. Use iteration 1.
textos.J-pole con el radiador en curva de Koch:: J-pole with the radiator as a Koch curve: shorter for the same frequency.
textos.J-pole con radiador de Koch: sin masa, s: J-pole with Koch radiator: no ground, fed with coax. For a mast.
textos.J-pole recta: adapta de 868 MHz a 2,4 GH: Straight J-pole: it matches from 868 MHz to 2.4 GHz (it already comes with the wider gap); the Koch J-pole is more compact.
textos.J-pole recta: con el hueco entre brazos: Straight J-pole: with the wider gap between arms and the tap at 26 % of the adapter (the defaults since 0.3.0) it matches at 868 MHz (−15 dB), 915 MHz (−10 dB), 1.2 GHz (−9.7 dB), GPS L1 (−11.8 dB) and 2.4 GHz (−12 dB), with η of 86 to 92 %; simulated without centring and not measured. At 5.8 GHz it does not match (the real part stays at ~20 Ω). If you change the gap or the tap, simulate again: the radiator length is calibrated for those values.
textos.JLC alta frecuencia y flex (0,1 mm): JLC high frequency and flex (0.1 mm)
textos.Justo: la antena nominal cubre la banda,: Borderline: the nominal antenna covers the band, but with those tolerances it may fall outside. Leave margin or plan to tune it after manufacturing.
textos.La GPU ha fallado ({0}): se usa la CPU: The GPU has failed ({0}): the CPU is used
textos.La J-pole no lleva plano de masa: suelda: The J-pole has no ground plane: solder the coax to the tap pads (live conductor to the long arm, braid to the short one) and take it downwards, along the axis of the adapter.
textos.La alimentación queda a {0:.1f} mm de un: The feed is {0:.1f} mm from one side of the board and the connector needs {1:.1f} mm: the board is {2:.1f} mm too narrow (or change the antenna position).
textos.La alimentación va por un extremo: los t: The feed is at one end: the far sections receive less current, so going beyond 4–5 sections hardly gains anything.
textos.La altura de la toma ajusta la impedanci: The tap height adjusts the impedance: raise it if the S11 lies in the low-impedance region of the Smith chart and lower it if it lies in the high-impedance one.
textos.La antena sale este % más larga (frecuen: The antenna comes out this % longer (lower frequency) and the silkscreen marks where to cut to raise it.
textos.La antena sale este % por debajo y las m: The antenna comes out this % lower and the marks show where to cut
textos.La antena va en el borde superior de est: The antenna goes on the top edge of this board: rotate it to choose the side.
textos.La banda va de {0:g} a {1:g} MHz: centra: The band goes from {0:g} to {1:g} MHz: centre the antenna at {2:g} MHz, not at {3:g} MHz.
textos.La cara superior tiene {0} piezas de cob: The top face has {0} separate pieces of copper
textos.La disposición simétrica con cruce no co: The symmetric layout with crossing does not correct the beam tilt and worsens the match (−10 dB versus −15.7 dB for the normal one). «All equal» is better.
textos.La frecuencia salta varios % con pequeño: The frequency jumps several % with small changes in height (mesh noise with the meander): the tuning may need more iterations. With a small ground it may not reach −10 dB.
textos.La línea de la simulación aparece cuando: The simulation line appears when the design is saved, unchanged and simulated.
textos.La placa no tiene un contorno cerrado en: The board has no closed outline on the Edge.Cuts layer.
textos.La primera vez descarga unos 15 MB; desp: The first time it downloads about 15 MB; afterwards it stays in the browser cache. Everything is computed in your browser: nothing is sent to any server.
textos.La rama es demasiado corta para el cruce: The branch is too short for the strip crossing: increase the spacing.
textos.La ranura ahorra la cola del transformad: The slot saves the transformer tail (~λg/4 under the patch)
textos.La red pierde ~{0:.1f} dB: con este sust: The network loses ~{0:.1f} dB: with this substrate the large array compensates little compared with a smaller one.
textos.La resistencia de entrada del anillo es: The ring's input resistance is 3–15 Ω (the radiation resistance, ~1.5 Ω): without the π network S11 comes out near 0 dB. The π network (Z1, Z2 and Z3) is enabled: “Tune to the frequency by simulating” computes an L network with E24 values from the simulated Z and shows it (fitted in Z1 and in Z2 or Z3); with a measurement, the assistant gives the real values.
textos.La resonancia está un {0:+.1f} % desviad: The resonance is {0:+.1f} % off and this antenna has no cut/section margin: correct it with the π network or redesign.
textos.La resonancia ya está en la frecuencia o: The resonance is already at the target frequency.
textos.La separación placa–reflector ajusta la: The board–reflector spacing tunes the impedance: measure and, if needed, change the length of the spacers (±2–3 mm) before touching anything else.
textos.La simulación NO cubre la banda entera: The simulation does NOT cover the whole band
textos.La simulación terminó sin resultado (mir: The simulation ended without a result (see the console).
textos.La toma suele estar entre el 10 y el 40: The tap is usually between 10 and 40 % of the adapter for 50 Ω.
textos.La zona de antena mide {0:.1f} mm de alt: The antenna zone is {0:.1f} mm high and below it the connector needs {1:.0f} mm of ground: the board must be at least {2:.1f} mm high.
textos.La zona de antena mide {0:.1f} mm de anc: The antenna zone is {0:.1f} mm wide and the board only {1:.1f}: {2:.1f} mm are missing.
textos.La εr del FR4 de JLC está pendiente de m: The εr of JLC's FR4 is still to be measured with the coupon: the real frequency can move ±2–3 %.
textos.La εr y la tanδ del PTFE son las del lam: The εr and tanδ of the PTFE are the laminate maker's (unmeasured) and JLC does not publish tolerances: measure the real frequency with the coupon. Order the board in their high-frequency service (2 layers, ENIG).
textos.Lado del cuadrado que ocupa la curva. Fi: Side of the square occupied by the curve. It sets the frequency: larger means lower. «Resize» computes it.
textos.Largo de cada brazo del dipolo (entre ex: Length of each dipole arm (between ends) [mm]
textos.Largo de cada brazo del dipolo. Fija la: Length of each dipole arm. It sets the frequency: longer means lower. «Resize» computes it.
textos.Largo de cada elemento de media onda: fi: Length of each half-wave element: it sets the frequency. «Resize» computes it.
textos.Largo de cada parche: fija la frecuencia: Length of each patch: it sets the frequency. «Resize» computes it.
textos.Largo de cada tramo de media onda: fija: Length of each half-wave section: it sets the frequency. «Resize» computes it.
textos.Largo de la CPS sobre la masa [mm]: Length of the CPS over the ground [mm]
textos.Largo de la línea de 50 Ω desde el conec: Length of the 50 Ω line from the connector to the antenna.
textos.Largo de la línea de dos tiras: también: Length of the two-strip line: it also adjusts the match.
textos.Largo de las aletas: más largo, más gana: Length of the fins: longer, more gain and more bandwidth, and a longer board.
textos.Largo del 1.er director (fracción del di: Length of the 1st director (fraction of the dipole)
textos.Largo del balun impreso (la tira central: Length of the printed balun (the central strip): separates the antenna from the connector.
textos.Largo del parásito (fracción del largo): Length of the parasitic (fraction of the length)
textos.Largo del parásito respecto al del parch: Length of the parasitic relative to the patch (slightly below 1 widens the band).
textos.Largo del plano de masa cuando es manual: Ground plane length when manual. Below λ/4 the frequency rises and the radiator must be lengthened.
textos.Largo del primer director respecto al di: Length of the first director relative to the dipole. Shorter than the dipole so that it directs forwards.
textos.Largo del radiador: fija la frecuencia (: Radiator length: it sets the frequency (longer means lower). «Resize» computes it.
Reflector length relative to the dipole. Longer than the dipole so that it reflects forwards.
textos.Largo resonante del parche: fija la frec: Resonant length of the patch: it sets the frequency (longer means lower). «Resize» computes it.
textos.Las bowtie casi se tocan en vertical: su: The bowties almost touch vertically: increase the spacing or close the aperture.
textos.Las muescas de Minkowski reducen el parc: The Minkowski notches shrink the patch by 10–25 % at the cost of bandwidth; the notch depth is the parameter with the most influence.
textos.Las pérdidas de la red crecen con el tam: Network losses grow with size: on FR4, a 4×4 at 2.4 GHz loses ~3.5 dB. For large arrays or at 5.8 GHz, consider RO4350B.
textos.Las ramas de la red son más cortas que e: The network branches are shorter than the 70.7 Ω λ/4: increase the spacing.
textos.Las vueltas de la pista se pisan ({0:.0f: The turns of the track overlap ({0:.0f} % of the area): the curve is too dense for that width; lower the iteration/order, narrow the track or enlarge the antenna

Putting the antenna on your board (the «_integrar» footprint)
  1. Copy the Antenas.pretty folder into your project and add it in Preferences → Manage Footprint Libraries.
  2. Place the footprint on a corner or edge of your board: the dashed line on the Dwgs.User layer marks the side that
     must coincide with the board edge (Edge.Cuts). The footprint origin is pad 1.
  3. Connect pad 1 to your 50 Ω line (microstrip with a continuous ground underneath). On the IFA, pad 2 is the via to ground and shares
     copper with pad 1: give them the same net (ground) or accept the DRC short-circuit warning, which is the antenna's own.
  4. The footprint has a keep-out zone (no tracks, vias or ground fill on any copper layer): fill the ground zones (B)
     and check that they do not enter it. If your KiCad version does not apply it, draw an identical keep-out zone.
  5. Stitch the ground with vias (every λ/20, about 6 mm at 2.4 GHz) along the edge of the ground next to the antenna zone.
  The «_ejemplo_integrada.kicad_pcb» file shows a board of that size with the footprint placed.

textos.Simulada a 868 MHz (−17,5 a −19,8 dB), 1: Simulated at 868 MHz (−17.5 to −19.8 dB), 1.2 GHz (−10.6 dB with the tap at 0.37 and the adapter ×1.13) and 2.4 GHz (−9.2 dB); at 5.8 GHz it does not match (−3 dB). Efficiency 89 to 94 %. Not measured. At 868 MHz the Koch curve does not shorten the radiator: it comes out larger than the straight one.
textos.Simulada a 868 MHz, 1,2 GHz (−13,7 dB),: Simulated at 868 MHz, 1.2 GHz (−13.7 dB), 2.4 and 5.8 GHz (−12 to −22 dB, with more bandwidth than the thin IFA) with the tap, the height and the arm width centred by simulation. Not measured.
textos.Simulada a 868 MHz, 1,2 GHz, 2,4 y 5,8 G: Simulated at 868 MHz, 1.2 GHz, 2.4 and 5.8 GHz (−11 to −17 dB; −14 dB at 1.2 GHz with the height and the tap tuned) with the tap and the height centred by simulation. The tap sets the impedance: tune it by simulating. Not measured.
textos.Simulada de 868 MHz a 5,8 GHz (−13 a −18: Simulated from 868 MHz to 5.8 GHz (−13 to −18 dB), not measured. With the SMA connector, the ground sleeve is the second arm; the cable may radiate if the sleeve is short (use a ferrite when measuring).
textos.Simulado (868 MHz y 2,4 GHz): adapta con: Simulated (868 MHz and 2.4 GHz): matches with the computed L network; η ~40–50 %, narrow band
textos.Simulado a 2,4 GHz: no adapta (−0,6 dB,: Simulated at 2.4 GHz: it does not match (−0.6 dB, η 7 %) with any variant of the parasitic's gap (0.2 to 0.6 mm) or factor (0.94 to 0.98). It is a parasitic coupled on the same face, not a real stack (which would need a second board).
textos.Simulado con FR4 de 1,6 mm; la red en L: Simulated on 1.6 mm FR4; the L network is applied by circuit to the simulated Z of the ring: at 868 MHz (25 mm ring, 0.26 pF; 0.56 nH in series and 12 pF to ground) it matches to −33 dB with a 9 MHz band, η 43 % and −1.7 dBi; at 2.4 GHz (10.7 mm, no capacitor; 2.4 pF in series and 2 pF to ground), −30 dB with 44 MHz, η 50 % and −1.6 dBi. More than half the power is lost in the copper and the capacitor (Q of 250): raise the Q and the track width.
textos.Simulado en GPS L1, 2,4 y 5,8 GHz: no ll: Simulated at GPS L1, 2.4 and 5.8 GHz: it does not reach −10 dB in the band (best −4.4 dB on RO4350B at GPS L1 and −5.9 dB at 2.4 GHz) and the axial ratio never drops below 6 dB (< 3 dB is needed for circular polarisation). On FR4 the efficiency is 4 to 44 %. The diagonal sets the rotation sense (0: right-hand, 1: left-hand). The edge feed does not give circular polarisation in these tests: do not use it for GPS.

textos.Sin problema, el logo es opcional y la p: No problem, the logo is optional and the board is yours. If you share or sell it, it would help us a lot if you mentioned Chirptenna (in the description, with a link to the project…). That way more people can find it and improve it. Thanks!

textos.Sin terminar de validar: el centro de la: Not fully validated: the band centre jumps a lot with small changes and each iteration takes hours (17 M cells in the 2×2); with the default size it resonates 16 % low and the efficiency is ~22 %. At 5.8 GHz, enlarged ×1.2, it reaches −7.7 dB but with η 12 %.
textos.Sin testear ni validar: no se ha simulad: Not tested or validated: it has been neither simulated nor measured. The U-slot widens the band, but its size and position are not calibrated and shift the frequency: simulate and tune.
